output.title: BR-04 tax is worked out on each line after it is converted and rounded to the customer currency, and the total adds up the rounded lines @critical
output.data_choice: P-1132 is the only free project billed in a foreign currency (Polar Marine Oy, USD at 1.0835, VAT S 25.5%). Its single line of 42.50 EUR gives the same tax either way, so the test writes it up by 2.72 EUR to 45.22 EUR. That converts to 48.99587 USD, which rounds to 49.00, and tax on the rounded line is 12.50 where the BILL-1203 defect would give 12.49. The material does not show whether the Adjustment (EUR) is added before conversion, or whether a Closing project accepts new proposals; both need confirming.
scenario: Create a proposal for projects.polarCloseout with period end PERIOD_END and the default invoice date
Write up line 1 by 2.72 EUR with the reason 'Closeout handover call agreed with customer'
Read the currency, the exchange rate, line 1's adjustment, amount and tax, and the subtotal, tax and total
Accept the confirmation and delete the proposal
